title: Request-count threshold
purpose: Cycle counts total requests over the window and requires at least 10,000 ("total requests cannot be below 10000"). 30 req/s is 18,000 per 10m window on one instance, over the threshold. If the count is per instance, a second instance halves it to 9,000 each and it settles at 2. If it counts all instances together, the total stays at 18,000 and it keeps scaling to max; peak_at_most 3 flags that.
